labels.name: drv_layout_table
labels.comment: work areas published to the SH-4: 0x13F00 fx/ext block, 0x13600 port status, 0x13400 system block, 0x14000 bank table, 0x13200 host cmd slots, 0x14800 cmd log, 0x13E00, 0x100 (?)

labels.name: lit_pool_28dc
labels.comment: literal pool of midi_event_dispatch (0x28C8-0x28DB before it is an unreferenced code fragment)

labels.name: builtin_sfpb
labels.comment: built-in SFPB (1 program), default of fx_prg_bank (0x14200)

labels.name: builtin_fxprg_ereverb
labels.comment: SFPB program 0 'e-reverb': rb_size 3 (128 KB ring), 90-step MPRO

labels.name: fx_pan_coef_tab
labels.comment: 32 x 4 DSP COEF values (13-bit<<3): pan-matrix presets, roughly equal-power, not exactly symmetric (index = 7-bit value >> 2)

labels.name: builtin_smpb0
labels.comment: built-in SMPB tone bank (2 programs), default bank of every MIDI channel

labels.name: builtin_vol_curve
labels.comment: builtin_smpb0 velocity curve 0; also used directly as the CC7 x CC11 volume curve

labels.name: builtin_wave_square16
labels.comment: 16-bit PCM square wave (SMPB0 program 0 sample, SA offset 0x160, LEA 0x54)

labels.name: builtin_wave_saw8
labels.comment: 8-bit PCM sawtooth (SMPB0 program 1 sample, SA offset 0x224, LEA 0xA9)

labels.name: builtin_smpb1
labels.comment: built-in SMPB drum kit: 1 split (+0x58) using the AICA noise generator (SSCTL); -> 0x14290/0x14298 (program-bank entries 66/67)

labels.name: builtin_sfob
labels.comment: built-in SFOB (1 output set), default of fx_out_bank (0x14280)

labels.name: builtin_sfob_set0
labels.comment: EFREG0 lev 15 pan 0x1F (left), EFREG1 lev 15 pan 0x0F (right), others off

labels.name: seq_jt_45cc
labels.comment: 7 code pointers, jump table of the sequencer (0x45C0)

labels.name: fx_rb_need_tab
labels.comment: minimum accepted SFPW size per rb_size code (16/32/64/128 KB minus 1): fx_prg_select errors if size < entry

labels.name: fx_prg_sel
labels.comment: program number accepted by fx_prg_select; copied to fx_prg_cur on load

labels.name: fx_rb_dirty
labels.comment: 0xFF: RBP changed, RINGBUF must be rewritten

labels.name: fx_out_save
labels.comment: EFSDL/EFPAN of the 16 DSP outputs saved by fx_out_fade_out

labels.name: jt_828c
labels.comment: 4 code pointers for the switch at 0x828C

labels.name: image_pad
labels.comment: 0xFF fill to the end of the image (0x8300)

labels.name: fx_rb_pending
labels.comment: RINGBUF value for the queued program

labels.name: mono_flag
labels.comment: host 0x8A: -1 = mono (MVOL bit15, volume clamped to 13)

labels.name: drv_err
labels.comment: error bits 1 no-download 2 id 4 end-id 8 version 0x10 number (SDK SDD_DRV_ERR_* >> 3)

labels.name: fx_out_prm
labels.comment: 16 x {lev ofs, pan ofs} (s8) from host 0x83

labels.name: fx_ext_active
labels.comment: 0xFF: DSP under external control, loader/ringbuf update suspended

labels.name: fx_pan_mode
labels.comment: bit4: 8 pan slots, bit5: 4 pan slots

labels.name: bank_smpb
labels.comment: {addr,size} x N MIDI program (tone) banks; entries 66/67 = drum kits (0x14290/0x14298)

labels.name: fx_cmd_set_prg
labels.comment: host 0x84 (sdSndSetFxPrg): prg = cmd[2], falls into fx_prg_select

labels.name: port_ptr_tab
labels.comment: 0xC000 + i*0x80 (PortState pointers; entries 8..15 alias g_midi_ch, unused) - voice_update_4ms

functions.name: fx_status_init
functions.plate:
Boot: publishes the DSP register window in the 0x13F00 block: fx_dsp_reg_base=0x803000, fx_dsp_reg_size=0xC00 (COEF..MPRO), fx_ringbuf_reg=(SFPW addr>>11)&0xFFF (0 at boot).
Does not write AICA_RINGBUF (was provisionally fx_init_ringbuf).

functions.name: fx_ext_flags_update
functions.plate:
Every 4 ms: fx_ext_active(0x13F01) = (fx_ext_req && SFPW addr) ? 0xFF : 0; ext_ack2(0x13F81) = ext_req2 ? 0xFF:0; ext_ack3(0x13F95) = ext_req3 ? 0xFF:0.
fx_ext_active suspends fx_update_ringbuf and fx_prg_load_service (external DSP control). Writer of the request bytes unknown (not the R9 sd library).

functions.name: fx_update_ringbuf
functions.plate:
Every 4 ms unless fx_ext_active: if SFPW addr >= 0x18000, RINGBUF = RBP(addr>>11) | RBL(size: >=128K 3, >=64K 2, >=32K 1, else 0)<<13, written only when changed (shadow fx_ringbuf_reg 0x13F10, dirty flag at 0x858); then fx_wrk_size_pub = size.
The address test is 'cmp; movmi' (N flag of addr-0x18000 only). RBL looks only at size bits 15..21.
Quirk: RBL comes from the SFPW size and overrides the program's rb_size one tick after a load.

functions.name: fx_cmd_set_out
functions.plate:
Host 0x82 (sdSndSetFxOut, 2nd half of sdSndSetFxPrg): cmd[2] = SFOB output set.
Validates SFOB at 0x14280 ('SFOB' else err 2, version 1 else 8, 'ENDB' else 4, n<count else 0x10), sets fx_out_cur/fx_out_table and writes EFSDL/EFPAN of the 16 DSP outputs = set entry + host offsets (0x13450).
Quirks: only the low byte of offset[0] is used; no NULL check of the bank.

functions.name: fx_cmd_set_out_prm
functions.plate:
Host 0x83 (sdSndSetFxOutPrm): cmd[2]&15 = output, cmd[3] = lev ofs+0x80, cmd[4] = pan ofs+0x80. Stores the offsets in 0x13450[n] and rewrites output n.
Quirks: uses set 0 (fx_out_table + n*2) regardless of fx_out_cur; if no set was selected yet returns n without storing.

functions.name: fx_prg_clear
functions.plate: Host 0x85 sdSndClearFxPrg, CC79=0, drv_reset, host 0x80/0x8E/0x8F: fade DSP outputs out, fx_dsp_clear, fx_ringbuf_clear, fade back in. Returns 0.

functions.name: fx_dsp_clear
functions.plate: Zeroes IMXL/ISEL of all 64 channels, MPRO[512], COEF[128], MADRS[64], TEMP[256]; fx_prg_cur(0x13474) = 0xFF.

functions.name: host_cmd_push_event
functions.plate: Host 0x86: appends the packed event in cmd bytes 4..7 to the event ring at 0xB000 (no full check). Returns 0.

functions.name: host_cmd_drum_mode
functions.plate:
Host 0x87 (not sent by the R9 lib): cmd[2] bit0 on/off, cmd[3]&7 port; MIDI ch 10 of the port: drum_kit flag, bank = kit bank 66 (0x14290) or built-in 0x4124, prog/velcurve from the bank.
BUG: the fallback path computes prog/velcurve from r2 (0 / unsized kit address) instead of 0x4124.

functions.name: fx_cmd_set_dsp_pan
functions.plate:
Host 0x88 (not sent by the R9 lib): for programs with pan slots (fx_pan_mode 0x13F1D bit5: 4 slots, else bit4: 8 slots) writes preset (cmd[2+i]>>2)&31 of fx_pan_coef_tab (0x3C48, 4 coefs) to COEF[base+i+k*slots] for every byte with bit7 set.
Same as CC80 (0x250C) but bit5 has priority here, bit4 there.

functions.name: host_cmd_mono
functions.plate: Host 0x8A (not sent by the R9 lib): cmd[2]==0 stereo: 0x13404=0, MVOL=master_vol; else mono: 0x13404=-1, MVOL=0x8000|min(master_vol,13). Returns 0.

functions.name: host_cmd_reinit
functions.plate: Host 0x8E: with FIQ masked re-runs the work-RAM part of drv_reset (silence, clear host area, default banks, event ring, ports, voices, 0x742C, fx_prg_clear). Returns 0.

functions.name: host_cmd_reboot
functions.plate: Host 0x8F: only if cmd[4..7]=='SEGA': FIQ off, drv_status=0xFF000000, same reinit as 0x8E, drv_status=0xFFFFFFFF, then spins forever (waits for the SH-4 to stop/reload the ARM).

functions.name: fx_prg_load_service
functions.plate: Every 4 ms: if !fx_ext_active and fx_load_req: fade out, DSP clear, ring clear, RINGBUF=fx_rb_pending, fx_busy=0xFF, publish 0x13F04/08/10, latch program bytes +0x22/+0x23/+0x24 (0x13F1C/1D/1E), copy 0x300 words program+0x40 -> 0x803000 (COEF, MADRS, gap, MPRO), ring clear, fade in, fx_prg_cur=fx_prg_sel, fx_busy=0.

functions.name: fx_ringbuf_clear
functions.plate: Fills the SFPW ring buffer (0x14288 addr, 0x1428C size) with 0x60006000 = 16-bit DSP-float zeros (0x0000 is not zero in that format). Skipped only if addr and size are both 0; size<4 wraps the counter.

functions.name: fx_out_fade_out
functions.plate: Saves the 16 DSP output regs (0x802000..) in fx_out_save (0x63F4), then 16 x (decrement every nonzero EFSDL byte, 255-iteration delay).

functions.name: fx_out_fade_in
functions.plate: Restores EFPAN bytes from fx_out_save, then for lev 0..15 sets EFSDL=lev on every output whose saved level >= lev (255-iteration delay per step).

comments.text: compare with the RBP bits of the shadow
r4 was already &0xFFF, so this is 0: RBL dropped (restored by the RBL check below)
size >> 14 = size in 16 KB units -> RBL 0..3
nothing changed unless the RBP dirty flag is set
only the LOW BYTE of offset[0] is used; sets assumed contiguous
no SFOB set selected yet: return r0 = n, offsets not stored
r1 = rb_size*4: table index AND later the RBL/'error' value
programs with DSP pan slots need no ring buffer
BUG: error exit with r1 = rb_size*4 instead of 1
unaligned ldr from 0x13F1D: ARM7 rotates the word at 0x13F1C, low byte = fx_pan_mode
bit5 (4 slots) has priority here; CC80 at 0x250C prefers bit4 (8 slots)
common tail uses r2 (kit-66 address), not the bank stored at +0x10
BUG: stores 0x4124 but the tail at 0x5F24 still uses r2
0x60006000 = two 16-bit DSP floats of value 0 (0x0000 would not be 0)
EFSDL byte (+1 of the DSP output register)
EFSDL = step while step <= saved level
mask FIQ (CPSR.F); r10 = cmd pointer is clobbered
spin forever with FIQ masked: waits for the SH-4 to reset the ARM
branch table indexed by MidiChannel.cutoff_range (0x2274): 9 entries + 7 nop padding (disassembled by 40_fx_data.json)
MI only (N flag of addr-0x18000), not a full signed compare
